newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, forwards, bonds flat, ecu/drs idles.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, forwards, bonds flat, ecu/drs idles.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were stable in late dealings, bonds were fluctuating narrowly, holding morning levels and ecu/drachma was locked in the familiar 309.60/75 range, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards hold mid-session levels," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Trading activity is thin."
Secondary bond market volume reamined subdued and yields were little changed exhibiting an upward bias, dealers said.

"Bonds are idling but yield spreads over bunds, BTPs and others are large and I expect savvy investors to take advantage of them," said a senior bond dealer at a private bank. "The risk-reward trade-off favours Greek bonds at this point."
The dealer said bonds had lost their momentum in the short-run but the long-term outlook was the same and it was up to the government to take the initiatives needed to spark a new rally.
The mark was quoted at 157.30/40 from Tuesday's 157.380 fix, the dollar at 276.04/14 drachmas from 276.150 and the ecu at 309.69/79 from 309.75 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma has been hovering in the tight 309.60/75 channel," said a senior forex dealer at a foreign bank. "Volume has been thin in the last few days."
